title: Keep the risk decision current
teachingQuestion: How do treatment, control evidence and monitoring feed a new risk decision?
focalInsight: Risk ownership persists after treatment and is revisited when evidence or context changes.
caption: Risk ownership persists after treatment and is revisited when evidence or context changes.

nodes.label: Risk management
nodes.definition: Coordinate assessment, treatment, ownership, communication and review.
nodes.decision: Keep decisions aligned to business objectives and tolerance.
nodes.failureExample: A risk register is updated annually while the service changes weekly.
nodes.detail: Coordinate assessment, treatment, ownership, communication and review.

nodes.label: Risk treatment
nodes.definition: Select and implement one or more responses to the assessed scenario.
nodes.decision: Assign owners, resources, intended effect and success evidence.
nodes.failureExample: A treatment is listed without implementation responsibility or a deadline.
nodes.detail: Select and implement one or more responses to the assessed scenario.

nodes.label: Control types
nodes.definition: Preventive controls inhibit events; detective controls reveal them; corrective controls address resulting conditions.
nodes.decision: Choose the function needed for the failure path and combine functions.
nodes.failureExample: An alerting dashboard is counted as prevention without an enforcement action.
nodes.detail: Preventive controls inhibit events; detective controls reveal them; corrective controls address resulting conditions.

nodes.label: Control assessment
nodes.definition: Evaluate whether controls are designed, implemented and operating adequately.
nodes.decision: Define scope, test method, evidence period and limitations.
nodes.failureExample: A configured backup job is accepted without testing a restore.
nodes.detail: Evaluate whether controls are designed, implemented and operating adequately.

nodes.label: Continuous monitoring
nodes.definition: Gather and assess signals at a risk-appropriate cadence.
nodes.decision: Trigger review when exposure, control performance or context changes.
nodes.failureExample: New privileged accounts are ignored until the next annual audit.
nodes.detail: Gather and assess signals at a risk-appropriate cadence.

nodes.label: Risk reporting
nodes.definition: Communicate exposure, uncertainty, action and ownership to the decision audience.
nodes.decision: State the decision needed rather than only activity counts.
nodes.failureExample: A report shows alerts closed but hides an overdue high-risk exception.
nodes.detail: Communicate exposure, uncertainty, action and ownership to the decision audience.

nodes.label: Security metrics
nodes.definition: Measures with a defined population, method, period, owner and intended use.
nodes.decision: Use trends and context to judge effectiveness and improvement.
nodes.failureExample: A low incident count is treated as proof of strong detection.
nodes.detail: Measures with a defined population, method, period, owner and intended use.
